ns2:course.label: Limnology
ns2:course.description: (IB 349) Fresh water biology; study of the lake, pond, and river with emphasis on the physical environment as well as on the plants and animals which live in fresh water. Lectures, discussions, laboratory, and field work. Offered in alternate years. 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: IB 203; or consent of instructor.
